# QYL0600: Insecure endpoint

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Configuration` |

| Analyzer | `Qyl0600InsecureEndpointAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

HTTP endpoints expose data in transit to interception and man-in-the-middle attacks. Use HTTPS (TLS) for all production endpoints to ensure data confidentiality and integrity. Localhost and 127.0.0.1 are excluded as they are typically used for local development only.
